protocol.primary_comparison: each new arm minus current combined, matched received keys/tracks and raw generation
protocol.tuning: single shared parameter set frozen before any dataset output; no per-video oracle selection
protocol.adoption: overall quality and temporal tradeoff, per-video regressions and motion retention; no all-metric gate
protocol.scope: 11 source-disjoint endpoint windows: previous seven plus four DAVIS sources new to this postprocessing experiment

review.sampling: 11 predeclared central nine-frame strips; full-resolution central stills for walking and lady-running after strip review

samples.observation: Visibility synthesis follows the source harbor layout more closely in the fixed central samples; fine geometry remains imperfect.
Visibility synthesis adds a clearly separated second body/head contour and transparent limbs; baseline has lesser trailing blur. Confirmed at full-resolution local frame 24.
Cloth and arm overlays remain; visibility synthesis mixes inconsistent poses with fragmented fine contours.
No convincing visual improvement in the low-motion central samples; numerical changes are small.
Visibility synthesis makes outlines around foreground people and background structures more prominent; double contours remain.
Visibility-only equals current output; reference weights are zero. Wrong wave/surfer placement remains.
Visibility synthesis brings static vegetation/background detail closer to source; this short mostly static view does not establish fast vehicle motion recovery.
Visibility synthesis adds transparent/double outlines around the bus and background despite aggregate PSNR improvement.
Visibility synthesis creates substantial superposition of the person, tables and room geometry. Confirmed at full-resolution local frame 48.
Visibility synthesis adds transparent torso/leg outlines. Source pose and camera viewpoint remain mismatched.
Skater position remains wrong; visibility synthesis overlays background texture and does not establish restored motion.

review.conclusion: Numerical gains from visibility synthesis coexist with visibly stronger moving-object superposition. Adaptive cadence does not improve source-paired cadence overall.

decisions.adaptive_cadence: Do not adopt this implementation: cadence error increases on 10 of 11 PNG cases and mean PSNR drops; small perceptual gains do not compensate.
decisions.visible_keys: Retain as a quantitatively promising research candidate, defer default replacement: new four source windows increase false freezing, and sampled moving objects show conspicuous double contours.
decisions.both: Do not adopt this combination: small additional perceptual gains over visibility alone trade away flow/cadence performance and retain visual superposition.

adoption.reason: Overall quality and temporal tradeoff, including visible material regressions, rather than a requirement that every metric or video improve.
adoption.next_hypothesis: A visible received key can still disagree with generated pose or location. Resolve this correspondence before blending; adaptive timing must avoid removing useful smoothing on all uncertain intervals.
